summary: Authored a five-phase plan for recapturing the parent record's corpus baselines under the corrected probe. Established at plan time that the union fix landed 2026-11-04 16:42 (deployed 16:57), that the live untracked in-corpus contribution is currently 0, and that the parent's Phase-20 reading postdates the fix while its Phase-1 baseline (2026-10-16) predates it by ~19 days. The decisive structural finding carried into the plan: the parent's authoritative acceptance figure is a git-numstat sum over its own commits, which never consults the probe and cannot be moved by this correction in either direction.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan: capture the corrected reading of record, date and classify every recorded figure by instrument, bound the Phase-1 baseline's exposure and state the correction, apply the determinations to both parent plan files, then run the full gate set and close.
